label: Otomoto

discovery.auth: API key + OAuth user credentials (register as API partner, test account via api@otomoto.pl)

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_api** (confidence high). OTOMOTO offers a free, documented REST API (register as API partner) for dealers/integrators to manage their own adverts; no public cross-market search endpoint; also a car catalog API.

reason: Upload-only official API (https://www.otomoto.pl/api/doc/): OTOMOTO offers a free, documented REST API (register as API partner) for dealers/integrators to manage their own adverts; no public cross-market search endpoint; also a car catalog API. It manages the account's own adverts (create/update/delete) and has no public listing search, VIN decode or valuation; the automotive vocabulary is read-only (no write verbs), so it is recorded, not served.
